# p10k-rs v0.4.0

**Reach + hardening.** v0.4 opens with Nushell + bash transient closing
out the v0.3 "reach" theme, then folds in the bulk of the v1.0
"Security MAX" verification toolchain and a substantial round of P2
hardening + self-audit. The full road-to-v1.0 plan now stands at 6 of 7
phases done; only the soak + tag-1.0 remains.

This is a SemVer-minor (0.x) bump for the breaking changes that
accumulated since v0.3.0: `Shell::Nu` added to both `Shell` enums,
`RenderCtx.sync_output` added, the `show_on_upglob` `SegmentConfig`
field added, and `term_caps::set_cached_for_test` removed.
`cargo-semver-checks` flagged each correctly and is now a CI gate.

## What's new

### Shells

- **`p10k-rs init nu`** — Nushell support. Two-step `save then source`
  bootstrap (Nushell's static parser can't eval a piped string the
  way pwsh's `Invoke-Expression` can). Nushell exceeds the bash/pwsh
  posture on two axes: native `$env.CMD_DURATION_MS` makes
  `command_execution_time` live, and `$env.PROMPT_COMMAND_RIGHT` gives
  a real right prompt. Falls back to the git shell-out / gitoxide
  backend (no FIFO daemon).
- **bash transient prompt** — full binary-invocation wiring (all four
  `TransientPromptMode` variants, `--last-prompt-cwd`,
  `--prompt-cwd-history-file`, rc==0 / KeepPrompt-on-exit-2 gate,
  `bind -x` Return → redraw-then-accept-line chain). The cursor-escape
  collapse is **documented-partial**: single-row prompts only — bash
  exposes no reliable row count for wrapped/multi-row prompts, which
  keep the full ribbon (KeepPrompt-equivalent). Parity table updated.

### Config

- **`show_on_upglob` segment gate** — the third "show-*" gate.
  `Option<Vec<Glob>>` mirroring `show_in_dir`'s shape. Lexical
  `cwd.ancestors()` walk (symlink-cycle-immune); a segment with
  `show_on_upglob = ["package.json"]` is shown only when the marker
  exists in the cwd or any ancestor.
- **Schema is frozen** — new `insta`-driven snapshot test in
  `crates/p10k-rs-config/tests/schema_snapshot.rs` captures the
  user-visible TOML surface (default + lean-theme kitchen-sink) so a
  future schema drift surfaces as a diff. `schema_version = 1`
  unchanged across the 0.x line.

### Security hardening

- **P2 batch (`feat(security)` commit `2683944`)**: `context.rs` env
  surfaces now go through `SafeText::from_untrusted` at the render
  boundary; every hot-path fd open gets `O_CLOEXEC`
  (`open_owned_inner` in safety.rs, `open_fifo_safely` in
  gitstatusd.rs, `write_dump_tmp_atomic` in main.rs — via
  `rustix::fs::OFlags::CLOEXEC`, no new deps); the instant-prompt
  dump's parent directory is now ownership-checked via new
  `check_dump_parent_safe` (O_DIRECTORY + O_NOFOLLOW + O_CLOEXEC +
  fstat owner=us-or-root).
- **De-flake refactor**: `render_prompt` no longer reads sync-output
  capability from a process-global `OnceLock` mid-render —
  `RenderCtx.sync_output` is now a producer-set field, mirroring
  `shell_integration_active`. Closes a small I/O-free-rule leak and
  retires the `render_prompt_pins_exact_bytes_around_left_prompt`
  parallelism flake. (Source-breaking for in-tree segment crates;
  cleared by `cargo-semver-checks`.)

### Verification toolchain (CI)

- **MSRV gate** — dedicated 1.88.0 check+test job
  (`.github/workflows/msrv.yml`); the floor was pinned but never
  tested.
- **Miri gate** — `cargo +nightly miri test -p p10k-rs-config`
  (config is the one I/O-free crate that's miri-clean; core touches
  rustix syscalls in its documented exceptions).
- **cargo-semver-checks gate** — diffs every library crate's public
  API against the last release tag (`--baseline-rev`); 0.x rules:
  breaking change requires a minor bump.
- **SBOM in release pipeline** — `cargo sbom` job in `release.yml`
  emits SPDX 2.3 JSON as `p10k-rs-<tag>.spdx.json`, attached to the
  release after the build matrix completes.
- **Windows compile-check** — `cargo check --workspace --locked` on
  windows-latest per PR, catching portability regressions earlier
  than the per-tag release-matrix build.
- **cargo-fuzz scaffold** (`fuzz/`) — 5 libFuzzer targets ranked by
  attacker-input proximity: `gitstatusd_wire`, `toml_config`,
  `sanitize_for_terminal`, `wrap_for_shell_zsh`, `p9k_importer`.
  Seed corpora per target. CI smoke (60s/PR, 600s weekly Mondays
  12:00 UTC).

### Self-audit + disclosure

- **5 per-attacker-model audit docs** in `.review/2026-05-30T-self-audit/`
  walking THREAT-MODEL.md A1–A5 against current code with done /
  partial / open verdicts and file:line citations.
- **`SECURITY.md` extended** with responsible-disclosure (90-day
  window), supported-versions matrix (latest minor only), credit
  policy, no-cash-bounty statement, and a pointer to the self-audit.
  Fixed the stale "sigstore is future" wording — it shipped in
  `release.yml` and has been live since v0.1.x.

### Docs

- **`docs/src/migration.md`** — v0.1 → v0.4 upgrade guide (new
  mdBook page, linked in SUMMARY).
- **`packaging/RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md`** — 334-line release runbook
  covering pre-tag hygiene, the 6-triple matrix, sigstore + SLSA
  verification, per-channel manifest bumps, the crates.io path
  (still unpublished as of this release — documented gap), and the
  Traps section cross-referencing prior round-trip memory notes.
- **`CLAUDE.md` refresh** — workspace layout now includes the
  `p10k-rs-jj` crate; `p10k-rs-wizard` and `p10k-rs-ai` are no longer
  labelled "(stub)" (both ship working features); the "bash/fish
  stubs" doc-comment was wrong (both ship full features) — fixed;
  the "p10k-rs-git has the unsafe budget" line is now accurate ("zero
  unsafe blocks today; `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` crate-wide").
- **`docs/man/p10k-rs.1`** — `init nu` recipe + SEE ALSO entry.
- **`docs/src/reference/shell.md`** — Nushell + bash-transient
  sections, feature-parity table refreshed.

## Breaking changes (within 0.x — minor bump is the permitted vehicle)

- `p10k_rs_core::Shell::Nu` variant added (exhaustive enum).
- `p10k_rs_core::RenderCtx` gains `pub sync_output: bool` (struct
  literal callers must include it).
- `p10k_rs_shell::Shell::Nu` variant added (exhaustive enum).
- `p10k_rs_config::SegmentConfig` gains `pub show_on_upglob:
  Option<Vec<Glob>>`.
- `p10k_rs_core::term_caps::set_cached_for_test` removed (now-unused
  test helper; replaced by direct `RenderCtx.sync_output` injection).

Each is mechanical for in-tree consumers; no behaviour change for
end-users following the README + the migration guide.

## Deferred to a follow-up

- **Instant-prompt content signature** (sha2 over config-hash +
  schema-version + hostname + uid). Needs coordinated Rust↔zsh change
  to land cleanly; explicit out-of-scope for the overnight Phase-3
  swarm.
- **Type-enforced `SafeText` on the `Segment` trait** (slice β in
  THREAT-MODEL.md). All extant segments verified to wrap correctly
  by convention; the refactor lifts the discipline to the type
  system.
- **`cargo-check-external-types` gate** — tool-blocked: v0.4.0 needs
  rustdoc JSON format 56, current nightly emits 57, and a
  format-56-compatible nightly predates the 1.88 MSRV. Revisit when
  upstream catches up.
- **`-Z minimal-versions` gate** — explicitly dropped as low-ROI for
  an internal-lib app workspace; cascades endlessly with near-zero
  payoff.
- **crates.io publication** — gap documented in
  `packaging/RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md` with the publish path in dep
  order; v1.0 criterion #5 prerequisite.

## v1.0 plan status after this release

6 of 7 phases done. Phase 7 = 6-month soak then v1.0 tag. The
roadmap's plugin-API criterion #3 was rescoped: the v1.0 public stable
surface is the TOML config schema + the `Segment` trait + the CLI;
dynamic plugin loading is a 1.x additive feature.

683 tests, all six gates green (build / test / clippy / fmt / doc /
mdbook), plus the four new ones (MSRV / miri / semver-checks / fuzz
check).
